_note_cover: The manuscript's cover picture (image1.png, 1226x1283, no lettering) is byte-identical to the TG's, so the cover reuses the TG's word-free 122:78 crop, Real-ESRGAN upscaled to 2452x1568 (~510 DPI at 122mm).
_note_ansoneki: As in the TG, the ANSONEKI heading right after the hand-typed contents list is dropped with it (its one-line bios are too short to read as a real section). Put it back above the bios.
_note_toc: The contents page lists only headings it knows as units, not KAPETULU, so it came out empty: list every section heading (ANSONEKI + the 11 chapters), as in the TG.
_note_strands: The A./B./C. strand lines (KUHOSHA NAKUTIYILILA / KUTACHIKA KUDIZA KUTAÑA / KUTACHIKA KUDIZA KUSONEKA) come in as Word auto-lettered list items or as typed-letter paragraphs, so they printed as list lines and stranded at page feet. Make every one a heading, lettered as the manuscript letters them (KUHOSHA is always A, KUTAÑA B, KUSONEKA C - Chapter 6 auto-lettered its KUSONEKA line B). Two headings Word glued onto the next line are split back apart (Chapter 1's 'Zhakwila 1 ... Mudimu:', Chapter 11's 'B. KUTACHIKA KUDIZA KUTAÑA Mutu WANSAÑU: ...').
